CVE-2026-66906.note: CORRECTED 2026-09-02 (was 'unconfirmed likely-alias of CAMEL-24487'): confirmed via WebSearch this CVE is 'Camel-Azure-Storage-Blob: the downloadBlobToFile operation built the local download target from the remote blob name without constraining it to the configured fileDir', affected range per the public advisory 4.19.0-4.22.0, fixed by CAMEL-23942 (commit 55fcbaf8bc, first in 4.22.0) and further hardened against symlink bypass by CAMEL-24548 (unreleased, main only as of this run). camel-azure-storage-blob IS a used_component. Our pinned 4.8.8 predates the advisory's stated lower bound (4.19.0) but was independently confirmed by direct source read to contain the identical unguarded 'new File(fileDir, client.getBlobName())' pattern with zero containment check (components/camel-azure/.../BlobOperations.java) -> AFFECTS_US regardless of the published range. See reports/2026-09-02.md for full backport assessment (not alias of CAMEL-24487, which is a separate remote-file/FTP finding).

Reinforces the already-tracked CAMEL-24487 finding (AFFECTS_US since 2026-08-26): pinned 4.8.8's GenericFileHelper.java has zero containment check of any kind (re-verified this run via git show camel-4.8.8:...), so the underlying vuln class (writes escaping localWorkDirectory via ../ or symlink) is unchanged AFFECTS_US.
